IN CONNECTION WITH DELHI HALF MARATHON 2025 ON 12.10.2025 (SUNDAY)

📍Routes : Half Marathon Open & Police Cup (21.097 KM), Elite Athletes (21.097 KM), Open 10 KM (07:30 AM) – flagged off from Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium.
📍Traffic Regulation & Diversions: Roads along marathon routes will be regulated from 04:45 AM to 10:00 AM, cross traffic allowed at junctions as per density.

📍Suggested Routes: 
North-South: Ring Road → Ashram Chowk → Sarai Kale Khan → IP Flyover → ISBT Kashmere Gate. 
East-West: DND Flyover → Sun Dial → AIIMS Chowk → Dhaula Kuan → Brar Square → Naraina Flyover.
📍Stay updated through Delhi Traffic Police channels.
